title: ta_features_calculated_v1
description: Payload for EVT:TA_FEATURES_CALCULATED — bar-based TA features computed by ta_features domain.

bar_close_ts.description: Bar close timestamp in milliseconds (Unix epoch)

close.description: Last close price used for the TA calculation.

price_sma_20_deviation.description: Normalised deviation from SMA(20) — (close - SMA20) / SMA20

volume_sma_ratio.description: Volume / SMA(volume, 20) — ratio of current volume to its 20-bar average

price_momentum_5m.description: Price momentum over a 5-minute window (adaptive lookback by tf_sec)

price_momentum_1h.description: Price momentum over a 1-hour window (adaptive lookback by tf_sec)

price_momentum_1d.description: Price momentum over a 1-day window (adaptive lookback by tf_sec)

macd_signal.description: MACD signal line: EMA-9 of (EMA-12 - EMA-26)

atr_ratio.description: Normalized ATR: 1.0 + atr_14/close (centered on 1.0 for model convention)

bb_width_change.description: Change in Bollinger Band width vs previous bar

price_range_ratio.description: Current bar range: 1.0 + (high - low)/close (centered on 1.0 for model convention)

warm_up_bars.description: Number of bars in the buffer at time of calculation

required_warm_up_bars.description: Configured warmup threshold that flips is_warm=true.

is_warm.description: True when the buffer has at least required_warm_up_bars bars; false means payload is explicit warmup state, not a dropped event.
